stem.text: A uniform rigid bar XZ with negligible mass is $1.20\,\text{m}$ long. The bar is pivoted at point P. Three coplanar forces act on the bar as shown. Forces of $16\,\text{N}$ and $20\,\text{N}$ act perpendicularly to the bar at points X and Y respectively. Force $F$ acts at point Z at an angle of $30^{\circ}$ to the axis of the bar.
The distances along the bar of the pivot and of the forces are shown.

stem.alt: Bar XZ inclined upwards from X to Z, pivoted at P, with forces of 16 N at X, 20 N at Y and force F at Z at 30 degrees to the bar. Distances of 0.30 m, 0.30 m and 0.60 m are marked along the bar.

stem.text: The bar experiences a resultant moment about P of $6.0\,\text{N m}$ in a clockwise direction.
